description.value: You gain a +1 magical bonus to weapon attack and damage rolls made with your antlers. Spells cast using your antlers as a somatic or material component gain a +1 bonus to spell attack rolls. You also gain the ability to attune and unattune to your own antlers as though they are a magic item. While you are attuned to your antlers, you gain a +1 bonus to the Save DC of spells you cast.
